quotes.text: The lawsuit would drag on racking up costs on both sides until finally Pat.

The trolls had been asking how Patrick could afford such a costly and ill-advised lawsuit with most of them thinking there was all paid for by the Sci-Fi Writers Association which Patrick was a member of.
Some of the pests believe that SFWA stopped funding the lawsuit due to all of the dirt that they had dug up on the association, but I'm not too sure what the circumstances around this really are.
What we do know is that the lawsuit was now over for Patrick and he had been defeated.
So only a few weeks after his filed lawsuit, Pat was back in court again, but this time he could actually identify the person that he was taking to court.
One of the sticking points for this case was that Patrick claimed he had never threatened the pest, while the troll, who is named Andrew Nadski, claims that Patrick did threaten him.
The next thing of note was when OA wanted to attack the Sci-Fi Writers Association for fraud due to them claiming that the association used members funds to pay for Patrick's lawsuit.
So Pat began threatening to sue Samson unless they replaced the phone due to him thinking there was fake advertising.
